notes: The painting is the page (deeds/page): its frame, its castle header, DEEDS and the flourishes beside CLOSE. Its tab row, discs and rows are cleared back to the panel; the rule under the tabs is the painting's own at both ends.

DEEDS / VICTORY ROAD are a TabStrip standing on the painting's rule (y 447: the plates' bottom rim, rows 79-81 of the sheet's 87, on it), 68..870 as on the Victory Road, the same two plates at the same size, so the pair reads as one page under two tabs.

The seven category discs are their own crops at their painted places (centres 117..822.5, 117.6 apart, on y 512.5): lit together while no category is chosen; the chosen one lit and the rest dimmed as a TabStrip dims a tab that is off. A disc wears the rail's count bubble on its shoulder while a deed in it has a tier to claim.

The rows are row 1 of the painting as a template (row), 137 apart as painted, in a scroll (list) over the cleared panel. Template units are the painting's less (50, 575): the row plate's outer edge runs 3..130 as painted (578..705).

The medallion stands on the bronze's centre (139, 645 as painted) in every state: each state was cut centred on its own disc. The seal is row 4's, lifted 4 so its ribbons end on this shorter plate's bottom rim; CLAIM is row 3's, centred where painted; the count plate is row 1's.
One stretch band in the list's middle: on 941x2040 the list grows and shows more rows.

elements.note: DEEDS / VICTORY ROAD: a TabStrip over the cleared row (the painted plates stood 70..870, 377..447); the sheet's plates at 1:1 stand their bottom rims on the painting's rule at y 447
a category's disc, its ring's centre at (52, 52.5) of the crop; the count bubble on its upper right shoulder (the ring at 45 degrees, where TabStrip puts a plate's)

the rows, 137 apart from the painted row 1's top; six whole rows on the painting's canvas, ending under the sixth's shadow so no sliver of a seventh's rim shows over CLOSE's flourishes (on a taller phone the band grows it)
